project_type: Full-stack educational platform (Syrabit AI) with Python FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, and Cloudflare Workers edge layer
build_system: pnpm monorepo with per-package builds. Backend uses pip-compile for requirements. Edge uses wrangler. Frontend uses Vite.
test_framework: Backend: pytest with pytest-asyncio, conftest.py fixtures, httpx AsyncClient. Edge: vitest. Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react + Playwright for e2e.
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit
test_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest --tb=short -q; cd ../../apps/edge && pnpm test
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend pytest suite. 2. Run edge vitest suite. 3. Run frontend vitest suite. 4. TypeScript type-check edge and frontend.
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. 2. pip install from apps/backend/requirements.txt (strip hashes). 3. pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-cov.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv, Node.js 22 via nvm.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass. TypeScript must type-check. Ruff lint must pass for backend.
key_patterns: Backend uses Beanie ODM with Motor for MongoDB, Upstash Redis (HTTP REST client), FastAPI routers at app/api/v1/. Edge uses KV bindings, vitest tests in tests/ dir. Frontend hooks in src/hooks/, context in src/context/.
directory_structure: apps/backend/ (FastAPI app with app/, tests/), apps/edge/ (CF Worker with src/middleware/, tests/), apps/frontend/ (React/Vite with src/context/, src/hooks/), .github/workflows/ (24 CI/CD files), infra/, docs/, scripts/
